outreach_drafts.body:
ATTORNEY REVIEW ONLY — DO NOT SEND.
Target: Jagdeep Singh
Public fact hook / hypothesis: Rhoda AI just emerged from stealth with $450M Series A and unveiled FutureVision, a robot foundation model built on internet-scale video pre-training. The company is at the absolute peak of innovation velocity — a critical window for IP documentation. With the convergence of AI foundation models, robotics hardware, and video-predictive control, the human-contribution/attribution question for patentability is especially salient. Pre-seed investors and board will likely ask about IP position. The AI Patent Strategy Scorecard is the most valuable first-party tool for leadership to map their IP strategy now.
Suggested lead magnet: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard — /ai-patent-strategy-scorecard
LinkedIn awareness draft exists for internal review only; do not post or tag without exact approval.

Internal LinkedIn awareness draft:
What happens when a company raises $450 million to build robots that learn from watching videos?

You get a fundamental invention question:

If a foundation model trained on 1 million+ videos contributes to the system's behavior — who is the inventor?

The AI doesn't file the patent. The human contribution does.

And for a company building robot foundation models, the documentation gap between what the model learns and what humans design is wide.

For #founders: your first filing strategy should come before your first product launch.
For #investors: AI patent diligence is increasingly about process, not just claims.
For #AI researchers: publication and patent timing need to be planned together.

Educational starting point: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard
https://whiteford-ai-law-pages.vercel.app/ai-patent-strategy-scorecard

Guardrail: no outreach, email/SMS, workflow enrollment, trigger tags, LinkedIn/social action, Clio write, live CRM/Supabase sync, public/client-facing use, or send without Jeff exact approval plus attorney/conflicts/suppression review.
